This file freezes the public record of major DND/CAF capital programs: National Shipbuilding, fighter replacement, helicopters, and related vehicles. Headline commitment figures are program ceilings and reported estimates — open Auditor General, PBO, and departmental pages for each number. Delivery status is what you can verify; rhetoric is not.
Delivery counts and program names are public. Cost ceilings change — treat every dollar as provisional until you open the cited instrument.
